messages:
jamie: Putting this thread here for the v1->v2 migration banner + link fixes. Draft in staging: https://redwood.dev/r/4577. Need: banner copy, list of docs to redirect, and short SDK examples that show `compat: true`.

oliver: Banner suggestion: "Heads up: v1 API is deprecated — we recommend migrating to v2. See migration guide." Keep it short, link to migration guide, and add a small "Report issues" link. :loudspeaker:

mira: I'll take SDK snippets. Proposing two minimal examples: TS + Python. TS: 
```ts
// v2 preferred
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2' });
await client.models.create({ name: 'my-model' });
// compat mode (temporary):
const compatClient = new Redwood({ compat: true });
await compatClient.models.create('my-model'); // shim translates old signature
```
Note the comment about limited translation (90 days).

infra: infra will implement a redirect rule that preserves method and querystring. We'll emit header `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1` and `Location` to the v2 path. We plan a staged rollout to 3 regions this week.

jamie: docs grep results attached in PR shows ~10 occurrences in quickstarts and examples. Prioritize updating quickstarts first. I'll open a separate PR for quickstart edits.

oliver: One nit for the banner: add an anchor to the "breaking changes" section in the migration guide so we land people directly. Also ensure any code snippet referencing `model:` field is corrected.

mira: Python snippet for docs: 
```py
# recommended
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_version='v2')
client.models.create(name='my-model')
# compat
compat = Redwood(compat=True)
compat.models.create('my-model')
```
Add an inline note that compat will log a warning to console and to telemetry.

infra: test harness updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/redirects-staging (PR #210). Smoke tests show Location header and deprecation header present. Failing on one example where query params were dropped; patch incoming.

jamie: Assign: @mira SDK snippets, @oliver banner copy + anchor, @infra to finish redirect patch, me for quickstart edits. I'll draft the banner text and post for sign-off by EOD.

docs-bot: PR #4577 created by @jamie in docs-staging. CI: docs build succeeded.

oliver: Quick manual test (curl) to include in migration guide: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'
# -> 307 Temporary Redirect
#    Location: /v2/models
#    X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1
```
We should show how clients should follow redirects and re-POST when needed.

mira: also adding snippet showing how to enable compat in Go + note about semantics that cannot be auto-translated (webhook callbacks, structured response differences).

jamie: schedule 10min signoff tomorrow 9:30am PT. Please leave short reviews on PR. TL;DR: banner + redirects + 2 SDK snippets + quickstart replacements.

infra: patch merged resolving querystring passthrough. Tests green in staging.

jamie: thanks team. I'll post final banner copy and then we can flip the redirect flag in prod once quickstarts are updated."
